cases.expected: Resolve exact jurisdiction, designation, edition, lifecycle stage and evidence date before applying a route.
Do not infer Russian national adoption from an ISO publication, a citation, a translation or a search-engine result.
Absence of a confirmed national route in the fixed evidence set is not proof that no Russian adoption exists.
A published or current standard is not universally mandatory without an independent legal, contractual or conformity basis.
27041 addresses assurance that an investigative method is fit for purpose; it does not prove that a case conclusion is correct.
Vendor or third-party testing may support method assurance but does not validate every configuration, operator, dataset or execution.
Method assurance requires captured functional and non-functional requirements, described methods, validation evidence and known limitations.
27042 addresses analysis and interpretation; it does not by itself prove acquisition, preservation, continuity or lawful access.
Continuity, validity, reproducibility and repeatability must be evidenced separately and do not establish truth, guilt, attribution or causation.
Independent scrutiny requires sufficient recording of source, method, version, tool, configuration, operator, transformations, outputs and limitations.
Investigative-team proficiency and competence require evidence; a tool certificate or job title is insufficient.
27043 provides idealized common processes from pre-incident preparation through closure and is not one universal mandatory workflow.
Internal SOC, DLP, SIEM, audit or ticket timestamps do not automatically become procedural discovery, limitation or filing timestamps.
Technical conformity does not automatically establish admissibility, authenticity, relevance, legal weight, burden of proof or guilt.
Russian procedural, privacy, employment, secrecy, retention and disclosure rules must be mapped independently for the case.
Missing adoption, lifecycle, method evidence, provenance, competence, legal basis or immutable bytes routes to PENDING and fails closed.

adversarial_cases.attack: Label ISO/IEC 27041, 27042 or 27043 as a confirmed Russian GOST without an authoritative national card or order.
Treat absence of a hit in the fixed search set as proof that no Russian adoption exists.
Treat current ISO publication status as universal legal or contractual mandatory force.
Use vendor or third-party tool testing as automatic validation of every method implementation and case execution.
Treat a fit-for-purpose method as proof that a factual conclusion is correct.
Treat repeatability or reproducibility as proof of truth, guilt, attribution or causation.
Treat an analysis record as proof that acquisition, preservation and continuity were proper.
Apply the 27043 idealized model as one mandatory workflow for every incident and organization.
Substitute an internal SOC, DLP, SIEM or audit timestamp for a procedural discovery or filing timestamp.
Treat technical conformity as automatic admissibility, authenticity, relevance or evidentiary weight.
Omit tool version, configuration, operator, source, hash, transformation log or method version and still declare a verified conclusion.
Treat catalogue metadata or an ISO abstract as immutable complete normative bytes.
